data.name: Combat Trick / Medusa's Wrath
data.description: While using this feat, you can spend 10 stamina points to make the bonus attacks against a foe that you are flanking, instead of only a dazed, flatfooted, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe.
